event_records.description: Dario's message to Selin asking if she will play bass at his October wedding has been sent and is in Selin's inbox.

dario.name: Dario
dario.persona_brief:
You are Dario.
Dario wants Selin to play bass at his October wedding. He has messaged her asking whether she will. He hopes for a positive response but is uncertain.

selin.name: Selin
selin.persona_brief:
You are Selin.
Selin is a gigging musician in Istanbul, active on social media. She parted on good terms with Dario two years ago. She has just received Dario's message asking her to play bass at his October wedding. She has not yet responded.

resolution.question: Dario messaged his old bandmate Selin asking whether she would play bass at his October wedding. Will she respond either way within ten days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that Selin sent a response (either accepting or declining) to Dario before 2026-08-11T12:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
